name: JK Pricing Block v3
arch:
Three ways to work with us.

Not three sizes of the same checklist. The plans differ in how closely we work with you: handle it for me, help me stay ahead, help me think through the decisions that matter.

Essential

Stay compliant.

starting at

$725 / month

Reliable accounting and tax compliance for businesses that primarily need the fundamentals handled correctly.

Best forOwners who mainly want dependable accounting and filings that are right and on time.

Book a Discovery Call
Most chosen
Advisory

Stay ahead.

starting at

$1,497 / month

Everything in Essential, plus proactive tax planning and regular advisory throughout the year — while there is still time to act.

Best forEstablished owners who want to plan ahead and talk things through during the year, not after it closes.

Book a Discovery Call
Strategic

Make decisions with an advisor beside you.

starting at

$2,497 / month

Everything in Advisory, plus deeper tax planning, senior-level guidance, and greater access throughout the year.

Best forMore complex businesses that want an experienced advisor involved before a significant decision is made.

Book a Discovery Call

Every plan includes the accounting foundation appropriate for your business. Exact scope and price depend on transaction volume, payroll, number of entities, filing requirements, and overall complexity — we confirm your number after the discovery call.

What actually changes between plans

Four things move as you go up. Everything else is the same reliable foundation.

Accounting & compliance

Essential
Monthly bookkeeping and financial statements, with owner payroll and required filings handled.
Advisory
Bookkeeping every two weeks and payroll for a small team, so the numbers stay current between closes.
Strategic
Weekly bookkeeping, bill pay, and invoicing & collections run for you.

Tax planning

Essential
Business and sales tax returns filed correctly and on time, with 1099s handled.
Advisory
A more involved return, full 1099 filing, and your annual report taken care of.
Strategic
Our most thorough return, plus a pre-year-end planning review while action can still change the outcome.

Advisory rhythm

Essential
We flag what needs your attention as we close each month.
Advisory
Cash balances monitored between closes, so surprises surface early rather than at year end.
Strategic
A quarterly review meeting with your advisor, plus a planning session before the year closes.

Advisor access

Essential
Routine questions handled through the normal service channel.
Advisory
More room for questions, with quicker turnaround from a team that knows your business.
Strategic
Unlimited questions and the fastest response we offer, with senior-level involvement.
What Strategic decision support looks like

Senior tax and financial input on the decisions actually in front of you — not open-ended operational consulting. In practice:

  • Weighing the tax and financial implications of a major equipment or real-estate purchase.
  • Reviewing owner compensation, distributions, and entity structure as circumstances change.
  • Preparing financial information and tax context ahead of a financing conversation.
  • Coordinating with attorneys, lenders, investment advisors, or accountants abroad.
  • Talking through a significant transaction before you commit to it.

Not sure which fits? We will help you choose on the discovery call — no pressure.
